Common questions

Can I buy a badge without the check?

No. The tier is set by our reviewers after the checks pass, and the applicant cannot set it themselves. Paying for Blue or Gold buys the verification work and the placement, not the badge on its own.

Do free listings get a website badge?

Yes. Every approved listing gets the Listed on Getclient badge, and every listed business with a website is asked to display it. Blue and Gold listings show their tier on the same badge.

What happens if I cancel?

Your listing drops to Basic and stays in the directory. A Blue or Gold badge on your own website switches to Listed on Getclient within 24 hours because it checks its status live.

Do you take a commission on jobs?

No. Getclient charges a flat monthly subscription. What you agree with a client is between you and them.

Is there a contract?

No lock-in. Monthly, cancel anytime. Verification is re-run every 12 months while you are subscribed.
